title: Compare Salaries with LAG and LEAD
description: Compare each employee's salary with the previous and next employee using LAG and LEAD.

data.text: Write a query to show each employee's salary alongside the previous and next employee's salary in the ordered list.

data.title: SQL Solution
data.code:
SELECT
    EmployeeID,
    FirstName,
    LastName,
    Salary,
    LAG(Salary) OVER (ORDER BY Salary) AS PrevSalary,
    LEAD(Salary) OVER (ORDER BY Salary) AS NextSalary,
    Salary - LAG(Salary) OVER (ORDER BY Salary) AS SalaryDiff
FROM Employees
ORDER BY Salary;

data.title: Explanation
data.text: LAG() returns a value from a preceding row; LEAD() returns a value from a following row. The default offset is 1. LAG(Salary) OVER (ORDER BY Salary) gives the salary of the row just before the current row in salary order. The first row's LAG returns NULL.
